notes: BUG_AUDIT_LOG.md added as a canonical doc 2026-07-28 (N17 pilot Task 3 fix): BUG-130 (line 3056, create-vs-update misroute in core/lead_candidate_handler.py) and BUG-140 (line 3198, unrelated-lead overwrite risk, still pending) are both registered, unfixed, and 142 lines apart in the same log section — the pilot's Librarian-track investigation grepped BUG-130 and never read far enough to find BUG-140. See task_profiles/profiles.json's `turn_coordinator_routing.bounded_local_expansions`, which now inlines both entries into the bundle so this cannot be missed by stopping at the first match.
No class TurnCoordinator exists on main; Phase 0 TurnEnvelope instrumentation is observation-only.
route_request and handle_lead_candidate are current de-facto routing/ownership surfaces.
The coordinator consumes typed signals and must not invent business state or approval policy.

PR #471 changed who legitimately owns a turn's final reply, not just how routing is observed: when FEATURE_SINGLE_SPEAKER_APPROVAL_UX is on and this turn queued an approval, run_agent() hands the reply to the Gateway (reply_owner="gateway") and returns immediately without a further Agent turn (app.py:3802 as of ffa678a7; line drifts with unrelated wording-only edits elsewhere in the file, e.g. PR #479/#480 — re-verified this audit that the boundary logic itself is unchanged). This is a conditional, code-level ownership assignment for approval-queuing turns specifically — it does not create a general reply_owner claim mechanism and does not resolve the concurrency race (a callback and a concurrent text turn for the same identity) described in docs/architecture/turn-coordinator/REPLY_OWNERSHIP_AND_APPROVAL_AUTHORITY_RESEARCH.md §1.3c, which remains unmitigated and research-only.

The same handoff path still invokes the RP5 shadow observer (observe_shadow_finalizer, app.py:3813 as of ffa678a7) on the Gateway-owned reply before returning — RP5's classification runs even though the Agent's own LLM text is never produced for that turn; see layer.rp5's notes.

edges.notes: Routing may select an approval path but cannot create approval truth.
